description: Displays details for a selected modeling element or relationship. Read-only (MO2) by default; with ReadOnly=false the name, the description and the SCALAR properties become editable inputs raising OnElementEdited/OnRelationshipEdited — source-backed fields, governance and complex JSON values are never editable (decision MODELING-INSPECTOR-EDITING). Phase 5 (decision MODELING-PROPERTY-SCHEMA): with a PropertySchema the schema's sections and typed fields replace the generic table for the keys it covers (markdown through the Tempo markdown editor, enum through TmSelect, dates through the pickers, duration as a number plus a display unit stored in MINUTES, entity references through the APG combobox with the host's async lookup, string lists and the repeatable structured list); every remaining key stays in an 'Other properties' table. Field errors come from the SHARED validator (or the host writer's save-time rejection) and render inline with role=alert plus aria-invalid on the input.

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: Selected modeling element. Takes precedence when both element and relationship are supplied.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the inspector root.

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements used to resolve relationship source and target display names.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the inspector is read-only (the MO2 default). The editor passes false when model editing is enabled for the current provider — then the name, the description and the scalar properties become inputs that commit on blur/Enter (Escape reverts); semantic type, notation, source metadata, governance and complex JSON values stay read-only.

parameters.name: OnElementEdited
parameters.description: Raised when an element field commit lands. The change carries only the edited fields (a null member means unchanged).

parameters.name: OnRelationshipEdited
parameters.description: Raised when a relationship field commit lands.

parameters.name: OnUndoRequested
parameters.description: Raised for the inspector-scope Ctrl+Z — the editor's own undo stack, never the diagram canvas keyboard scope.

parameters.name: OnRedoRequested
parameters.description: Raised for the inspector-scope Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Editor-owned actions rendered inside the header (the undo/redo pair and the docked Save/Discard while a Manual save is pending).

parameters.name: Saving
parameters.description: Whether a model save is currently in flight. Every editing input disables and the drafts are not re-seeded from the re-renders the saving state causes, so a keystroke mid-save cannot be silently wiped.

parameters.name: PropertySchema
parameters.description: The property schema of the SELECTED element/relationship, or null when the host registered no schema provider for the provider key (the 2.10.0 surface).

parameters.name: PropertyIssues
parameters.description: Validation issues of the selected element/relationship — the editor's shared-validator result plus the writer's save-time rejections. They render inline on their field (role=alert, aria-invalid) and as the issue dock rows.

parameters.name: LookupProvider
parameters.description: The host lookup provider for EntityReference/EntityReferenceList fields; null keeps those fields read-only (a reference cannot be picked without a catalogue).

parameters.name: ModelId
parameters.description: Model id passed to the schema/lookup requests.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: UI culture name for the lookup requests (null = the current UI culture).
